title: I Need My Aurora
style: Sophistipop with fretless bass, Rhodes piano chords, clean electric guitar, synth brass stabs, conga tumbao and brushed snare; 128 BPM, restrained late-night groove; breathy male baritone crooning in airy legato phrases, narrative verses and stacked backing vocals; tape saturation, plate reverb and sidechain pumping.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sometimes I just need to unload
Without their mood adding to the load
Say it all out, not worry if it's right
Or if it hurts, just let it out tonight

[Pre-chorus]
Not a lover, not a partner, not a friend
Just my pale redhead with green eyes, again

[Chorus]
I need my Aurora, I need her so bad
My time at your practice, the prescription pad
I need my Aurora, the talk and the warm
The rightful uneasiness, the calm and the storm

[Verse 2]
Gabi's my equal, my accomplice
But I can't hand her my darkest ghosts
The others hold a piece, never the whole
So I bring it all to where I feel whole

[Pre-chorus]
Not a lover, not a partner, not a friend
Just my pale redhead with green eyes, again

[Chorus]
I need my Aurora, I need her so bad
My time at your practice, the prescription pad
I need my Aurora, the talk and the warm
The rightful uneasiness, the calm and the storm

[Bridge]
Maybe it's lust, maybe it's plain
Or maybe she just gets how I'm wired, how I'm made

[Final chorus]
I lust my Aurora, I lust her so bad
My time at your practice, the prescription pad
I lust my Aurora, the talk and the warm
The rightful uneasiness, the calm and the storm
